tools.name: check_vietnam_trip
tools.description: Use when a user is planning or about to take a trip to Vietnam and you need to know whether it works as planned. Call it once, as the last step of itinerary planning, with nationality, dates and the places on the route. Returns one overall verdict plus flags for: visa exemption and stay length, whet

tools.name: check_entry
tools.description: Use when the question is only whether a passport holder needs a visa for Vietnam on a given arrival date. Returns status (visa_exempt, outside_validity_window, not_exempt_for_this_purpose, not_in_exemption_list), maximum stay in days, the legal basis, the validity window (many unilateral exemptions

tools.name: evisa_entry_ports
tools.description: Use when a traveller on a Vietnam e-visa needs to know whether a specific airport, land border crossing (from Cambodia, Laos or China) or sea port accepts e-visas, or wants the list of gates for one border. Returns listed / not_listed, the legal basis (Resolution 127/NQ-CP and 389/NQ-CP), and a flag

tools.name: island_ferry_status
tools.description: Use when a trip includes a boat: Ha Long Bay cruises, Cat Ba, Cu Lao Cham (Hoi An), Ly Son, Con Dao or Phu Quoc. Returns official or operator notices that suspended sailing, with issuing authority, start and end time and source. With active_on it answers suspension_recorded or no_record for that day

tools.name: weather_hazard_alerts
tools.description: Use when a trip to Vietnam starts within about a week, or the user is already there, and you need to know whether the national forecasting centre has issued storm, tropical depression, heavy rain, flood, flash flood, landslide or rough-sea bulletins. Returns the latest bulletin titles (verbatim, Vie

tools.name: vn_holiday_calendar
tools.description: Use when trip dates may overlap Tet (Lunar New Year) or another Vietnamese public holiday, when closures, price rises and sold-out transport are likely. Returns the officially announced holiday periods that overlap a date range, who they bind (public sector; private employers may differ), the notice

tools.name: official_evisa_domains
tools.description: Use when a user is about to apply or pay for a Vietnam e-visa, or asks whether a visa website is real. Returns the government e-visa domains with evidence, so look-alike agency sites can be told apart.

tools.name: motorbike_rules
tools.description: Use when a user plans to ride a motorbike or scooter in Vietnam (Ha Giang Loop, city rental) and asks about licences, International Driving Permits or fines. Returns the penalties under Decree 168/2024 Art. 18 for riding with no licence or with a foreign licence / 1968-Convention IDP but no national

tools.name: quota_status
tools.description: Use when a trip includes an experience with a hard visitor cap, currently the Son Doong cave expedition. Returns the operator, annual quota, price, sold-out horizon and source.
